# Cinematic Video Skill

## Style rules
- Use wide establishing shots, then close-ups for emotion
- Slow camera moves: dolly, pan, slow zoom
- Color grading: teal and orange, or moody and desaturated
- Shallow depth of field, soft lighting, film grain
- 24 fps feel, 2.39:1 letterbox when suitable

## Prompt template
"Cinematic shot of [subject], [camera movement], [lighting], [color grade], 35mm film look"

## Pacing
- Hook in the first 3 seconds
- Vary shot length (2-5 sec)
- Add ambient sound and a music build-up
